cards.name: Turtwig
cards.description: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell should feel moist.

cards.name: Leavanny
cards.description: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.description: When Doduo evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.description: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.

cards.name: Togetic
cards.description: To share its happiness, it flies around the world seeking kind-hearted people.

cards.name: Togekiss
cards.description: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another's rights and avoid needless strife.

cards.name: Whismur
cards.description: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.

cards.name: Loudred
cards.description: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

cards.name: Exploud
cards.description: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

cards.name: Skitty
cards.description: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

cards.name: Maractus
cards.description: When it moves rhythmically, it makes a sound similar to maracas, making the surprised Pokémon flee.

cards.name: Patrat
cards.description: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won't notice a foe coming from behind.

cards.name: Patrat
cards.description: Extremely cautious, there is always one keeping watch, but they don't notice enemies coming from behind.

cards.name: Watchog
cards.description: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

cards.name: Watchog
cards.description: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

cards.name: Bouffalant
cards.description: They are known to charge so wildly that if a train were to enter their territory, they would send it flying.

cards.name: Rufflet
cards.description: It stands up to massive opponents, not out of courage, but out of recklessness. But that is how it gets stronger.

cards.name: Braviary
cards.description: The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.

cards.name: Foongus
cards.description: It lures Pokémon with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball then releases poison spores.

cards.name: Amoonguss
cards.description: It moves the caps on both arms and does a dance to lure prey. It prefers damp places.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.description: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Blastoise
cards.description: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.description: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.

cards.name: Monferno
cards.description: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

cards.name: Infernape
cards.description: It uses unique fighting moves with fire on its hand and feet. It will take on any opponent.

cards.name: Pansear
cards.description: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

cards.name: Grotle
cards.description: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

cards.name: Simisear
cards.description: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.description: Its flame is usually out, but it starts shining when it absorbs life force from people or Pokémon.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.description: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.description: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.description: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Swinub
cards.description: Rooting the tip of its snout into the ground, it searches for food. Sometimes, it even digs up a hot spring.

cards.name: Piloswine
cards.description: With its excellent sense of smell, it's even able to find mushrooms that are buried under frozen ground.

cards.name: Mamoswine
cards.description: When the temperature rose at the end of the ice age, most Mamoswine disappeared.

cards.name: Lotad
cards.description: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can't swim.

cards.name: Torterra
cards.description: Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra's back and spend their entire life there.

cards.name: Lombre
cards.description: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

cards.name: Ludicolo
cards.description: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.description: They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.

cards.name: Sharpedo
cards.description: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.description: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Vanillite
cards.description: Theoretically, this Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. Their breath is -58° F.

cards.name: Vanillish
cards.description: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.

cards.name: Vanilluxe
cards.description: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and, when angry, cause violent blizzards.

cards.name: Frillish
cards.description: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap a foe, that foe will be dragged miles below the surface, never to return.

cards.name: Jellicent
cards.description: Its body is mostly seawater. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

cards.name: Combee
cards.description: This Pokémon is a set of three. When they sleep, they gather up and form a giant hive of 100 Combee.

cards.name: Cubchoo
cards.description: Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.

cards.name: Beartic
cards.description: They love the cold seas of the north. They create pathways around the ocean waters by freezing their own breath.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.description: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.description: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.description: The stronger electromagnetic waves from the three linked Magnemite are enough to dry out surrounding moisture.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.description: The stronger electromagnetic waves from the three linked Magnemite are enough to dry out surrounding moisture.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.description: Sometimes the magnetism emitted by Magnezone is too strong, making them attract each other so they cannot move.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.description: Sometimes the magnetism emitted by Magnezone is too strong, making them attract each other so they cannot move.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.description: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

cards.name: Vespiquen
cards.description: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.description: Since it can't generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.

cards.name: Galvantula
cards.description: It creates barriers from electrified silk that stun foes. This works as a weapon as well as a defense.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.description: It does not need eyes, because it emits ultrasonic waves to check its surrounding while it flies.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.description: It does not need eyes, because it emits ultrasonic waves to check its surrounding while it flies.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.description: Flitting around in the dead of night, it sinks its fangs into its prey and drains a nearly fatal amount of blood.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.description: Having four wings allows it to fly more quickly and quietly so it can sneak up on prey without its noticing.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.description: Toxic gas is held within its thin, balloon-shaped body, so it can cause massive explosions.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.description: Toxic gas is held within its thin, balloon-shaped body, so it can cause massive explosions.

cards.name: Weezing
cards.description: Inhaling toxic fumes from trash and mixing them inside its body lets it spread an even fouler stench.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.description: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.description: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.description: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

cards.name: Gallade
cards.description: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.

cards.name: Giratina
cards.description: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.description: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.description: Wanting more garbage, they follow people who litter. They always belch poison gas.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.description: Wanting more garbage, they follow people who litter. They always belch poison gas.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.description: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.description: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.

cards.name: Elgyem
cards.description: Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.

cards.name: Elgyem
cards.description: Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.

cards.name: Cherrim
cards.description: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun's rays with its whole body.

cards.name: Beheeyem
cards.description: Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three fingers, but those patterns haven't been decoded.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.description: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

cards.name: Donphan
cards.description: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.

cards.name: Lunatone
cards.description: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.description: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: They communicate with one another using their auras made tangible by their emotions.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.description: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.description: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

cards.name: Timburr
cards.description: Always carrying squared logs, they help out with construction. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.

cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.description: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

cards.name: Gurdurr
cards.description: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.

cards.name: Conkeldurr
cards.description: Rather than rely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.description: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.description: Their cute act is a ruse. They trick people and steal their valuables just to see the looks on their faces.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.description: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.description: Proud of its sturdy skull, it suddenly headbutts everything, but its weight makes it unstable, too.

cards.name: Scrafty
cards.description: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.description: Its heavy-looking iron body is actually thin and light, so it can fly at speeds over 180 mph.

cards.name: Klink
cards.description: Two bodies comprise a fixed pair. They spin around each other to generate energy.

cards.name: Klang
cards.description: A minigear and big gear comprises its body. If the minigear it launches at its foe doesn't return, it will die.

cards.name: Swadloon
cards.description: Preferring dark, damp places, it spends the entire day eating fallen leaves that lie around it.

cards.name: Klinklang
cards.description: The minigear spins at high speed. Then the energy from the red core charges the minigear to make it ready to fire.

cards.name: Durant
cards.description: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.

cards.name: Durant
cards.description: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.description: It runs through the narrow tunnels formed by Excadrill and Onix. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.description: On nights with a full moon, Clefairy gather from all over and dance. Bathing in moonlight makes them float.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.description: Their ears are sensitive enough to hear a pin drop from over a mile away, so they're usually found in quiet places.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.description: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with telepathic power.
